what: Income tax due on a gross taxable income, England / Wales / Northern Ireland, tax year 2026/27 (6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027). Non-savings income, standard Personal Allowance, no other reliefs.

source.status: rates and thresholds read from gov.uk on the date above; each row is arithmetic from those published rates (gov.uk publishes the rates, not worked totals)
quoted: The current tax year is from 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027.
Basic rate £12,571 to £50,270 20%; Higher rate £50,271 to £125,140 40%; Additional rate over £125,140 45%
Your personal allowance goes down by £1 for every £2 that your adjusted net income is above £100,000. This means your allowance is zero if your income is £125,140 or above.
Basic rate band: up to £37,700 of taxable income; higher rate band: £37,701 to £125,140 of taxable income
